description: Bean B4 brick a (qou-1p06): classical origin of the 1/2 in the per-loop measure. Canonical Jones-Markov n=2 weights are Schur-Weyl (3/4,1/4) at q=1, not Plancherel; three canonical origins of 1/2 coincide exactly at q=1 (1/[2]_q, S2-Plancherel, tr_M(sigma)); x q-independence excludes the q-families — the 1/2 is a decategorification-point constant with KL carrier b_s/[2]_q (b_s=[2]_q e+, ->1+s at q=1). B4 sharpens to one functorial normalization; remains OPEN. Nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact (sympy + corpus canonical y_lambda_at; Hecke channel eigenvalues per AGENTS 7a)

assertions.name: canonical_weights_are_schur_weyl_not_plancherel
assertions.detail: y_[2]+y_[1,1]=1 identically; at q=1 the canonical Jones-Markov weights are (3/4, 1/4) = (dim spin-1, dim spin-0)/4 — Schur-Weyl for V⊗V, NOT the S₂-Plancherel (1/2,1/2). The equal-weight reading of the 1/2 is not the canonical Markov weight reading (consistent with merged F2)

assertions.name: triple_coincidence_of_half_at_q1
assertions.detail: (a) idempotent normalization 1/[2]_q|_{q=1} = 1/2; (b) S₂-Plancherel dim²/2! = 1/2 (both irreps); (c) canonical tr_M(σ)|_{q=1} = 1/2 (= 3/4 − 1/4, the crossing's signed channel content). Three DISTINCT canonical objects, all equal to 1/2 exactly at the decategorification point q=1

assertions.name: q_independence_of_x_discriminates
assertions.detail: readings (a) 1/[2]_q and (c) tr_M(σ) are q-DEPENDENT (at q=4: 4/17, 2/5 — both ≠ 1/2), but the 1-loop coefficient is −[2]_q·x EXACTLY with x q-independent (merged F3): neither q-family can sit inside the measure. The classical normalization is EVALUATED AT q=1 — the 1/2 is a decategorification-POINT constant, exactly the KL-functor-at-q=1 shape (§7b item 2)

assertions.name: kl_bridge_half_is_kl_to_idempotent_conversion
assertions.detail: the positive KL element b_s = σ + q⁻¹ has channel eigenvalues ([2]_q, 0): b_s = [2]_q·e₊ identically, b_s² = [2]_q·b_s; at q=1 it decategorifies to 1+s = 2·(Young symmetrizer of S₂), so e₊ = b_s/[2]_q and the 1/2 at q=1 IS 1/[2]_1 — the KL-to-idempotent conversion factor at the decategorification point. The 1/2 has a canonical KL carrier

result.discrimination: x q-independent (merged F3) => normalization evaluated AT q=1; the 1/2 is a decategorification-point constant
result.kl_carrier: b_s = sigma + q^{-1} = [2]_q e+; at q=1 -> 1+s = 2*(Young symmetrizer); 1/2 = 1/[2]_1 = KL-to-idempotent conversion
result.verdict: B4a DELIVERED (scope-(a); derives no clause; no fit; nothing wired): the classical 1/2 of the per-loop measure has THREE canonical origins that coincide exactly at q=1 — (a) idempotent normalization 1/[2]_q, (b) S₂-Plancherel weight, (c) the canonical Markov trace of the crossing (3/4 − 1/4, Schur-Weyl weights — NOT Plancherel) — and the established q-independence of the measure x EXCLUDES the q-families (a),(c) as q-carrying forms: the normalization is a decategorification-POINT constant, matching the KL route. The KL bridge is exact at n=2: b_s = [2]_q·e₊, decategorifying at q=1 to twice the Young symmetrizer — the 1/2 is the KL-to-idempotent conversion 1/[2]_1. B4's open statement SHARPENS to the single functorial normalization: the loop expansion weights the q=1 KL-normalized channel projector by the universal unit a₀·α. B4 remains OPEN — this brick derives the carrier and the discrimination, not the normalization. NO tier change.
